observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR camera with 'Nikon' and 'D800' clearly visible on the top plate.
The lens has 'NIKKOR 85mm 1:1.8 AF-S' printed on it, matching the seller's claim.
The camera body shows signs of use: dust on the lens, minor scratches on the body, and some wear on the grip.
The screen is off in photo 1 and 2, and no power indicator is visible.
No battery, charger, or accessories are shown in any photo.
The background in all photos is a store shelf with boxes and items, suggesting a retail or second-hand environment.

claims.claim: This is a UK Used Nikon D800 Camera with Nikkor 85MM 1.8 AF-S Lens
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows 'Nikon D800' on the body; photo 1 shows 'NIKKOR 85mm 1:1.8 AF-S' on the lens.
No photo shows the camera powered on or in operation. The screen is off, and no power indicator is visible. No proof of functionality is provided.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera turning on, screen displaying, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal damage or fungus not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens elements, especially the front and rear, under bright light to check for haze or scratches.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens with potential internal damage

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo showing the battery and charger included, or a video of the camera powering on with battery.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing battery and charger

risks.risk: Camera may have hidden mechanical or electronic faults
risks.proof: Video of the camera menu navigating, shutter operation, and autofocus performance.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the camera turning on and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the lens elements under bright light.
Photo of the battery and charger included.
Video of the camera menu and shutter operation.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
